correctness.rationale: Independent hypergeometric absence probabilities give exact F. Analytically proved disjoint-species marginal concavity and a family formula D(x,y)=(1-x/r)y(y-1)/(K(K-1))+x(r+1)y/(rK). For x>0 and y=r+1-x, xy>=r and K>=r+2 imply D(x,y)>D(0,r+1). Exact exhaustive certificate covers all abundance-pair multisets with census 2..6, quotienting actual symmetries, proving first nonnesting census 6 and unique adjacent-gap class. Two independent expectation algorithms agree on 1462 allocations; finite family verifier checks 117 parameter pairs. No computation is taken as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A budget planner might expect to extend an optimal survey by adding a draw; the exact first failure occurs already with six individuals and has a unique unavoidable consecutive-budget relocation up to symmetries. An infinite family makes the compulsory reset arbitrarily large, while disjoint habitat compositions provably restore nesting. The sharp boundary, unique first strong witness, and structural positive regime motivate the fact beyond an arbitrary finite curiosity or computational table.
